0: I-Synechocystis yi-cyanobacterium engenalo i-nucleus. Iphila ngokukhanya:enza ukudla kwayo ngokukhanya, ikhipha i-oxygen, kungekho ama-chloroplast. Emarabhini isetshenziswa ukufunda umjikelezo we-hydrogen.
1: I-Anabaena variabilis ngumucu wezeli. Ezinye izeli ziguquka ziba ama-heterocyst azibopha i-nitrogen, kuyilapho omakhelane benza ushukela. Echibini ihlinzeka nge-nitrogen eboshiwe.
2: I-Spirulina (Arthrospira) yisipirali yezeli ezinama-vesicle womoya. Imi eduze nephezu kwamanzi, yenza i-photosynthesis, futhi ingadliwa. Emdlalweni iyisikrufu esikhulu esiluhlaza esesiphuzwaneni samanzi.
3: I-Nostoc punctiforme ngumucu wamabhangqa ezeli ogcwele islimi esimbozayo. Ihlala yodwa noma ihlangene nezitshalo. Ikoloni ibukeka njengodonga lwamabhangqa aluhlaza.
4: I-Oscillatoria limnetica ngumucu ohamba doisizela. Ikhala yakwesokudla nakwesokunye futhi ingakwazi ukwenza i-photosynthesis ngaphandle kokukhipha i-oxygen. Ivamile emdonse nasemuva wamanzi.
5: I-Microcystis aeruginosa yikoloni yeslimi, njalo inembula (i-microcystin). Idala ubukhula olwedlulele oluhlaza emanzini. Emmdlalweni iyibhola yekoloni eluhlaza, ukuyidla kuyingozi.
6: I-Gloeocapsa izeli ezibini ezimbozwe izimbozo ezinemibala. Ihlala ematsheni nasemhlabathini futhi ichwethele i-UV. Echibini ngama-cocci amabili amancane ekhothini.
7: I-Lyngbya majuscula ngumucu omakhuluzekile we-cyanobacteria. Ingakhipha izimbula ezenza ukucasuka. Idala amabulukwe eduze nezinkambu ezifudumeleyo.
8: I-Chlamydomonas reinhardtii iseli eliluhlaza enamuzila omibili nendawo yokubona. Idada iya ekukhanyeni. Isibonelo esidumile se-genetics ye-algae.
9: I-Chlorella vulgaris ibhola eliluhlaza elingahambi. Icwebezela ngokushesha futhi inamaphrotheni amaningi. Yisidlwa sezilwane ezincane futhi yisihloko sokudla kwesikhala.
10: I-Volvox globator isibunga esingenalutho sezinkulungwane eziyizeli. Amakoloni amadala avuthiswa ngaphakathi bese ekhishwa. Emadlalweni ikoloni eluhlaza elikhulu.
11: I-Euglena gracilis idla ngezindlela ezimbili: inama-chloroplast futhi ikwazi ukudla. Isiboni esibomvu silandela ukukhanya. Ihlaza emini; ebumnyameni iguqukela ekudleni.
12: I-Scenedesmus quadricauda ivamise ukuba nezeli ezine zohlu olulodwa, ezinezikhunta emiphethweni. Izikhunta zenza ukugwatywa kube nzima. Ayidadi — intanta namanzi.
13: I-Haematococcus pluvialis iseli eliluhlaza elihambayo; lapho izimo zinzima iba bomvu (i-astaxanthin) futhi ikhulisa udonga olunzima. Ama-cyst abomvu aphila ngesikhathi esomile.
14: I-Dunaliella salina ingenadonga olunzima futhi ihlala emanzini anosawoti omningi. Igcina i-beta-carotene, ngako-ke ibonakala isipuzi-bomvu. Inemsila emibili.
15: I-Micrasterias rotata idesmid elisicaba lesinkanyezi. Inamaceleni amabili afanisiwe nezindawo ezisikiwe ezijulile. Ayihambi; iphila ngokukhanya emanzini amakhaphethei asimuncu.
16: I-Navicula idiatom enosimo lwenqolowa, enamivalvu ye-silica. Ithwalela phezulu komhlabathi ngomumo we-raphe. Igobolondo liyashiywa ngemva kokufa.
17: I-Pinnularia viridis idiatom enkulu ehlotsheni lwe-pennate. Igobolondo le-silica elinephathini evumelaniswe. Ithwalela kancane phansi.
18: I-Cyclotella meneghiniana idiatom eyindilinga. Intanta njengediski; igobolondo lizingcezu ezimbili. Iplankton evamile.
19: I-Diatoma vulgare idiatom edweba zibe yisakhiwo esizig-zag. Ikoloni yandisa ukumelana kumugqa wamanzi.
20: I-Rhodospirillum rubrum isipirali esiphushephe. I-photosynthesis engenalo i-oxygen kanye nokudla ama-organic. Umbala obomvu uvela kwi-bacteriochlorophyll.
21: I-Chromatium vinosum ibacteria ye-sulfur esiphushephe. I-oxidize i-hydrogen sulfide futhi igcina ama-granule we-sulfur. Ihlala emkhathini we-oxygen ne-sulfur edibene.
22: I-Porphyridium cruentum i-algae elibomvu eliseli elilodwa. I-phycoerythrin inika umbala obomvu wegazi. Inokumbozo okunamathelayo, ingenamsila.
23: I-Prochlorococcus marinus yesona iseli esincane nesiningi kakhulu emhlabeni elenza i-photosynthesis. Itholwe ngawo-1980. Inikeza ulwandle ukudla.
24: I-Chroococcidiopsis thermalis iphila ezimweni ezinzima: ezomile, ematsheni, emisebeni yemisebe. Iyathathwa njengesibonelo sokuphila ngaphandle komhlaba. Echibini yikoloni yama-cocci eshayo kancane.
25: I-Bdellovibrio bacteriovorus isidlamlaza se-bacteria esincane. Singena njengesikrufu kwenye iseli bese sanda singakafiki ukuthi iseli iqhume.
26: I-Vampirococcus hlala ngaphandle kokudla, sosa okuqukethwe ngaphakathi ungangenanga. Yivampela ye-bacteria.
27: I-Daptobacter ingena kwi-bacteria engumthwali bese iyidla ngaphakathi. Umzingeli ongajwayelekile ngaphakathi kwezeli.
28: I-Myxococcus xanthus ibacteria yomphakathi. Eqenjini izungeza ukudla bese ikhipha ama-enzyme. Uma inswela ukudla yakha isiqu sokhiwane.
29: I-Bacteriovorax stolpii isizalwane solwandle se-Bdellovibrio. Ihlasela ama-Gram-negative futhi ihlala ku-periplasm yokudla.
30: I-Halobacteriovorax umzingeli we-bacteria ochwethele usawoti. Indlela efanayo: chitha udonga bese ukhula ngaphakathi.
31: I-Peredibacter starrii elinye isidlamlaza se-BALO. Yiseli esinomsila esisheshayo, sincinyana isimo, ehlasela ama-rod amakhulu.
32: I-Monas guttula yiflagellate encane edla ezinye. Ibamba i-bacteria ebusweni be-detritus.
33: I-Oikomonas termo yiflagellate enosimo lwesithonjana senanzi. Inumsila omunye; izingela efimini le-bacteria.
34: I-Anthophysa vegetans yikoloni esibambozini se-iron-manganese. Izeli zihlezi zibumba iqoqo bese zibamba i-bacteria.
35: I-Chilomonas paramecium icryptophite engenalumbala. Inemsila emibili; idla ama-organic ahlakazekile ne-bacteria encane, ingenama-chloroplast.
36: I-Cercomonas longicauda yiamoeboflagellate enomsila omude. Ikhweba bese igwatya i-bacteria nge-pseudopodia.
37: I-Heteromita globosa iflagellate yomhlabathi. Inemsila emibili ohlukanisa ubude; umdlani oyisisekelo we-bacteria emhlabathini.
38: I-Bodo saltans yikinetoplastid. 'Idansisa' endaweni yodwa, ibambelele ngumsila wangemuva, bese ethatha i-bacteria.
39: I-Procryptobia sorokini isizalwane se-Bodo. Idada yenkulu yodwa bese ihlasela ngomsila wangaphambili.
40: I-Trypanosoma brucei umthwali wegazi obangela isifo sokulala. Inomembrane ojikelezayo kanye nomsila omunye. Echibini isetshenziswa njengesibonelo somzingeli ominyane.
41: I-Leishmania donovani umthwali kwezeli zabantu. Unomsila esibungwini, ungenamsila kwi-macrophage.
42: I-Monisiga brevicollis yichoanoflagellate, isizalwane sezilwane. Ikholo ye-microvilli ihlanzela i-bacteria.
43: I-Salpingoeca rosetta yichoanoflagellate ehlezi endaweni ye-lorica. Ingakwazi ukwakha i-rosette. Ihlanza amanzi ahamba.
44: I-Codonosiga botrytis ikoloni yechoanoflagellate esibambozini esisodwa. Amafilter amaningi esiquweni esisodwa.
45: I-Paramecium caudatum isicathulo esijwayelekile. Inezinwele ezincane ezinkulungwane, umumo womlomo, nama-vacuole acothulayo. Ihlanza i-bacteria.
46: I-Paramecium bursaria isicathulo esinama-symbiont we-zoochlorella. Luhlaza ngaphakathi: ushukela ovela kwi-algae emini, ukuhlamba ebusuku.
47: I-Stentor coeruleus i-trompete eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka esifika kumillimitha. Ivula ibe yisiphuzo bese idonla amanzi ngezinwele ezincane. Ingadada noma ihlale.
48: I-Stentor polymorphus isizalwane se-stentor eluhlaza, njalo nama-zoochlorellae. Isimo siguquka sitrompete siba yibhola.
49: I-Vorticella campanula insimbi esibambozini esicothulayo. Isibambozi sijikelezwa isipirali masinyane. Iseli ngokwayo ayidusi.
50: I-Vorticella microstoma insimbi encane. Isiqu esifana nesipiringi, indawana yomlomo emyango. Itholakala kakhulu kwi-detritus.
51: I-Didinium nasutum umzingeli webhareli wama-paramecium. Ikhuluma ama-toxicyst bese igwatya ukudla konke, noma ungakhulu kunayo.
52: I-Spirostomum ambiguum isigari esinde kakhulu. Icothula izikhathi eziningi ngesikhashana esincane. Izinwele ezincane zihamba ngosipirali.
53: I-Blepharisma americanum i-ciliate epinki. Umbala we-Blepharismin uzwa ukukhanya. Ihlanza futhi ingahlasela izeli ezincane.
54: I-Euplotes patella ihamba ngama-cirri njengasezinyaweni. Ilicaba, ijikeleza ngokushesha. Isusa i-bacteria ezindaweni.
55: I-Stylonychia pustulata ihypotrich 'egijima' phansi. Ama-cirri amakhulu, umlomo ocacile. Isidlamlaza se-ciliate ezincane.
56: I-Oxytricha trifallax isibonelo se-genome: inuclei ezimbili nokubhalwa kabusha i-DNA okudidayo. Ihamba ngama-cirri futhi idla i-bacteria namaprotesti amancane.
57: I-Tetrahymena thermophila i-ciliate yelabhu. Ama-membranelle amisuka amane, uhlukaniso olushesha. Isibonelo se-telomere nezicilia.
58: I-Coleps hirtus ibhareli emapuletiniwe ekhalshi enezikhunta. Isilwane esidla okufile nesidlamlaza: luma abalimele.
59: I-Litonotus lamella umzingeli olicaba one-toxicyst eproboscis. Ipharalyze ukudla bese isosa.
60: I-Dileptus anser intsheba enam-extrusomes ebulalayo. Ihlasela ngesibunu, bese igwatya. Umzingeli omkhulu wesigaba esiphakathi.
61: I-Urocentrum turbo itophu elijikelezayo: ibhande le-cilia elilinganisele lijikelezaiseli endaweni yodwa. Ihlanza i-bacteria.
62: I-Zoothamnium arbuscula ikoloni enegatsha lezinsimbi. Isibambozi esicothulayo esisodwa sidonsa isihlahla sonke ngesikhathi esisodwa.
63: I-Opercularia coarctata yiperitrich ehlezi endaweni engenamsila wesipiringi. Ikhova limboza umlomo. Ihlanza futhi ayidusi.
64: I-Amoeba proteus i-amoeba edumile. Ama-pseudopodia azungeza ukudla. Ayinamumo oqinile, ayinazicilia.
65: I-Arcella vulgaris i-amoeba enedome eliqinile. Ama-pseudopodia aphuma kumumo wokuphuma. Ikhweba ezitshalweni.
66: I-Difflugia oblonga inegobolondo lama-grain wesihlabathi abophelelwa ndawonye. Ihlala emdonse.
67: I-Euglypha alveolata inegobolondo lezikeliwe ze-silica. Ama-pseudopodia amyengeza amancane. Umzingeli omncane we-bacteria.
68: I-Nebela collaris inegobolondo lephutha elakhiwa ngezikeli ezibyiwe. Amanzi asehlathi namakhaphethei.
69: I-Centropyxis aculeata idiski enegobolondo enezikhunta. Umumo wokuphuma usukele kancane. Ikhweba kwi-detritus.
70: I-Actinophrys sol iheliozoan: ama-axopodia amancane akhishwa konke indawo. Ukudla kunamathela kumashishu bese kudonswa ngaphakathi.
71: I-Actinosphaerium eichhorni iheliozoan enkulu enanuclei eziningi. Amashishu afanayo, iseli enkulu kakhulu. Idla iziciliate nama-rotifer.
72: I-Raphidiophrys pallida iheliozoan esezikeli. Amashishu anamahluzi we-silica. Umzingeli weplankton olimazele.
73: I-Rotaria rotatoria i-rotifer engachwethe ukomile. Icorona ijikeleza idonse ukudla emlomeni. Isilwane sangempela esinezeli eziningi.
74: I-Philodina roseola i-rotifer epinki ye-bdelloid. Ikhweba emhlabathini omanzi futhi idada. Kukhona abesifazane bodwa; akukho besilisa.
75: I-Brachionus plicatilis i-rotifer yeplankton enelorica. Isidlwa sezinhlanzi ezincane ekuliseni izinhlanzi. Ihlanza ama-algae ne-bacteria.
76: I-Keratella cochlearis i-rotifer enomkhonta omude we-lorica. Umkhonta usabisa abazingeli. Iplankton ejwayelekile yechibi.
77: I-Asplanchna priodonta isaka engenalorica, i-rotifer eyisidlamlaza. Igwatya amanye ama-rotifer neziciliate ngokuphelele.
78: I-Chaetonotus maximus igastrotrich. Egobile ngezikeli, ihamba phansi. Idla i-bacteria ne-detritus.
79: I-Lepidodermella squamata igastrotrich encane esezikeli eziphendaphendayo. Ijikeleza ngokushesha endaweni yodwa.
80: I-Macrostomum lignano isilwane esisicaba esincane. Inemisipha yangempela nemehlo. Isibonelo sokulungiswa kabusha. Izingela amaprotesti amancane.
81: I-Stenostomum leucops isilwane esincane esinezicilia. Ihlukanisa ibe ngumucu wezooids. Idla i-detritus nezilwane ezincane.
82: I-Microstomum lineare isilwane esisicaba esidla ama-hydra bese lifaka izeli zazo ezibuhlungu esikhunjeni salo. Ngumucu wezooids.
83: I-Prostoma graecense inemertean yamanzi amnandi. Iproboscis ende idubula ukudla. Umzingeli omkhulu wasohlwini ohlukile.
84: I-Trichoplax adhaerens iplacozoan, esezilwaneni ezilula kakhulu. Ikhweba njengesheethi bese igaya ukudla ngaphandle. Ayinamlomo.
85: I-Saccharomyces cerevisiae iyasti yokwenziwa kwesinkwa. Ikhihleza, idla ushukela, ikhipha i-CO2 nolutshwala. Echibini ihlanza ama-organic ahlakazekile.
86: I-Candida albicans iyasti engakhula ibe mimicu. Igciwane lomuntu elibamba ithuba uma umzimba ubuthakathaka. Emadlalweni yifungasi le-detritus.
87: I-Mucor mucedo yifungasi yesinkwa. Ama-sporangia emizileni, ukhula olushesha phezu kokufiwe. Azingeli abaphilayo.
88: I-Rhizopus stolonifer yifungasi emnyama yesinkwa. Ama-stolon nama-rhizoid asabalala phezu komhlabathi. Iphula isitashi.
89: I-Penicillium chrysogenum yifungasi enjengebhrashi, umthombo we-penicillin. Ama-brush we-conidia. Ibhubhisa ama-organic bese icindezela i-bacteria eseduze.
90: I-Aspergillus niger i-aspergillus emnyama. Amahlokho ama-spore ajikeleze. Umkhiqizi we-citric acid embonini. Yifungasi esidla izinto ezifile.
91: I-Batrachochytrium dendrobatidis ichitridi yezixelegu. Ama-zoospore anomsila omunye. Echibini isetshenziswa njengesibonelo sefungasi lamanzi.
92: I-Chytriomyces aureus ichitridi lamanzi epoleni nama-algae. Ama-sporangia okhuni; ama-zoospore adada aya komhlabathi.
93: I-Allomyces macrogynus yifungasi lamanzi enemicu yangempela. Iguqula phakathi kwediployd nehaployd. Ama-zoospore anomsila wangasemuva.
94: I-Bacillus subtilis irod yomhlabathi. Ama-spore achipa ukubilisa. Iphula amaphrotheni; isibonelo se-Gram-positive.
95: I-Pseudomonas putida irod yokuhlanza. Idla nakwimikhiqizo ye-petroleum. Inemsila ohambayo, ikhula ngokushesha kwi-detritus.
96: I-Streptomyces coelicolor ibacteria yomhlabathi enomicu. Idala iphunga lomhlabathi (i-geosmin) nama-antibiotic amaningi. Ama-spore emicu.
97: I-Cellulomonas fimi iphula i-cellulose. Irod eliphuzi kwi-detritus yezitshalo. Ngaphandle kwayo ama-algae afile aza ahlala isikhathi eside.
98: I-Thermus aquaticus thermophile yasemthombeni ashisayo. I-Taq polymerase yisisekelo se-PCR. Echibini ebanda ilele kancane.
99: I-Deinococcus radiodurans ngunqoba wemisebe. Ibuyisela ndawonye i-genome eqhekeze nge-awa. Udonga olunzima, ama-tetrad wezeli.
1001: I-Sexual Eukaryote isibonelo sokufundisa sokuzala ngokocansi. Ubulili obubili, udibanisa ama-gamete, hhayi ukuhlukaniswa kabili okulula.
T4 Bacteriophage: I-T4 myovirus enkulu ye-E. coli. Umsila ucothula ungene i-DNA. Emizuzwaneni engama-30 iseli iqhume bese amaphage amaningi aphuma.
Lambda Phage: I-Lambda phage ethemperithe. Ingafakwa kukhromozoma ilale (lysogeny) noma icekishe iseli masinyane (lysis).
T7 Bacteriophage: I-T7 unomsila omfushane nokopisha okushesha kakhulu. Isistimu ethandwa kakhulu e-synthetic biology.
Phi-6 Phage: I-Phi-6 phage ye-RNA enokumbozo lwe-lipid. Ifakele i-Pseudomonas. Imembrane eyodwa eyingcosa kumphage.
MS2 Phage: I-MS2 phage ye-RNA encane engenamsila. Ibathelela kuma-pili we-E. coli wesilisa. I-genome yayo ibingeyodwa yezokuqala ukufundwa.
Neuro-Parasite: I-Neuro-parasite eyiqambisiwe yechibi. Inamathela kuma-eukaryote bese iphazamisa ukuziphatha komthwali de umthwali abe yisithwali.
Sexual Eukaryote: I-Sexual Eukaryote isibonelo sokufundisa sokuzala ngokocansi. Ubulili obubili, udibanisa ama-gamete, hhayi ukuhlukaniswa kabili okulula.
